title: populus nigra var. pyramidalis
intro: Populus nigra var. pyramidalis, commonly known as Black Cottonwood or Black Poplar, is a deciduous tree that belongs to the willow family (Salicaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Populus nigra var. pyramidalis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
